findings.issue: `isSheaf_underlying_presentationLimitPresheaf_rational` uses nothing about the presheaf except the single hypothesis `hrat` obtained at line 60: `exists_eq_ofArrows`, `mem_restrictedTopology_iff`, `functorPushforward_ofArrows`, `hπ`/`Subsingleton.elim`, `compatible_homOfLE_iff` and `inf_mem_spaRationalOpens` are all presheaf-generic, yet the lemma is stated only for `presentationLimitPresheaf P Aplus ⋙ ι ⋙ forget` under `[IsTateRing]`, `[IsStronglyNoetherian]`, `hP`, `hAplus`.

summary: Hypotheses on the new statements are at the right strength (the empty-open lemma is proved without Tate/noetherian/completeness, and the nonemptiness assumption is genuinely removed). But the basis-to-all-opens argument is re-proved at the postcomposed special case instead of generalizing the existing presheaf-independent lemmas, and the private rational-cover lemma bundles a presheaf-generic site argument with the Tate/noetherian hypotheses.
